body.p: 2024 年新课标适应性测试语言运用第一节为 15 道四选一，共 15 分；第二节为 10 道填空，共 15 分。无提示词的空填写 1 词。
本测试按 2024 年适应性测试的结构出题，限时 20 分钟，掌握线 0.7。以上时间和掌握线为本课程的建议，不是官方规定。2025—2026 年各地试卷是否都用这一结构，尚未确认。

groups.text:
A town museum planned a display about its old railway. It lent photographs to a community hall, while a school sent drawings and maps. Visitors would receive tickets at the entrance. Jun, a volunteer, was asked to arrange the [1] from the museum. Each picture needed a small card beneath it, and the museum had prepared the [2] in advance. The cards gave the names of the stations, the places shown and the [3] when the pictures were taken.

Jun carried the cards in a wooden [4] and put it beside a desk. The frames were heavy, and one photograph had a torn corner. As the volunteers lifted the frames, the box tipped over. Some cards landed on the desk, but several were [5]. Jun decided to [6] for them before putting any picture on display. He found some in an open [7] under the desk. A second volunteer looked inside a cloth bag, while another checked a shelf.

The missing cards had fallen onto a piece of [8] in the drawer. Water had marked the paper earlier, but the writing on the cards was still [9]. Jun placed them on a dry cloth. While they were [10], the volunteers sorted the frames and checked the photographs against the museum list. Next, they [11] the pictures into two groups: stations and trains. They used a camera to [12] the display for their records. A teacher wanted to take a copy to the school and bring it back later. She asked to [13] it, and Jun agreed.

After the event, the photographs were [14] to the museum. Jun wrote the condition and location of each item in a [15]. His notes would help the volunteers plan another display.

items.why: 博物馆借出的是 photographs；drawings 和 maps 来自学校。
每张照片下需要一张卡片，labels 对应这些说明卡。
when the pictures were taken 指照片拍摄的日期。
后文 the box tipped over 表明卡片装在盒子里。
后文 The missing cards had fallen onto 直接说明有几张卡片不见了，用 missing。
后文找到卡片，search for 表示寻找。
后文 in the drawer 指出卡片落在抽屉里。
后文 the paper 与抽屉里的纸对应。
Water had marked the paper earlier 说的是水渍，but 引出相反的情况：字仍然能读，用 readable。第三项 damaged 与 but 前后的转折不符。
Jun 把卡片放在干布上，卡片在那里晾干。
into two groups 表示将照片分成两组，用 sorted。
used a camera 表明用相机拍摄展览。
教师要求取得一份供学校使用的副本，borrow 表示借用。
开头 It lent photographs to a community hall 说明照片是博物馆借出的，活动结束后归还，用 returned。第一项 lent 把借出的一方弄反了。
后一句 His notes 说明 Jun 写下的是笔记，记在 notebook 里。第二项 map 只对应 location，不能记录物品的状态。

groups.text: A group of students started a project to study the sounds around their school. At the first meeting, they [1] (decide) to record sounds in several places at the same time of day. Each student received a notebook in [2] to describe what could be heard. The group first visited the playground, [3] children were playing a game. They listened for a few minutes and wrote down the sounds they noticed. Later, they went to a quieter room and compared their [4] (note). One student pointed out that a sound could be familiar but still difficult [5] (describe) accurately. The group then made a list of words that might help. Their teacher encouraged them to listen [6] (careful) before choosing a word. At the next meeting, the students played their recordings and discussed [7] they had learned. They found it useful to include the place and time beside each recording. The class also prepared an [8] (exhibit) in the school library. Visitors could read the descriptions and listen to selected recordings. By the end of the project, the students had become more aware [9] the variety of sounds in familiar places. They were interested [10] collecting similar sounds the following term.

items.stem: [1] At the first meeting, they (decide) to record sounds.
items.why: 会议发生在过去，谓语用一般过去时 decided。

items.stem: [2] Each student received a notebook in _____ to describe what could be heard.
items.why: 介词 in 后用关系代词 which，指 notebook。填 order 构成 in order to，表示目的，也正确。

items.stem: [3] The group visited the playground, _____ children were playing a game.
items.why: where 表示地点；while 和 when 也可表示动作同时发生。
上下文指多条记录，note 用复数 notes。

items.stem: [5] A sound could be difficult (describe) accurately.
items.why: difficult 后用不定式 to describe。

items.stem: [6] Their teacher encouraged them to listen (careful).
items.why: 副词 carefully 修饰 listen。

items.stem: [7] The students discussed _____ they had learned. The word is the object of learned.
items.why: what 引导宾语从句，并在从句中作 learned 的宾语。

items.stem: [8] The class prepared an (exhibit) in the library.
items.why: exhibition 和 exhibit 都可以作名词，表示展览或展品。

items.stem: [9] The students became more aware _____ the variety of sounds.
items.why: be aware of 表示意识到。

items.stem: [10] They were interested _____ collecting similar sounds the following term.
items.why: be interested in 表示对某事感兴趣。
